summary: Phase-1 OpenAI Realtime Voice Assistant verified end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — /api/realtime-token mints valid ephemeral 'ek_...' keys with model='gpt-realtime', and /api/voice-command handles get_summary/get_balance/get_shipments plus soft-fails on unknown actions (no 500s). Frontend: voice orb renders at exactly x=314,y=760 (60x60) on dashboard, persists across /shipments, /ledger, /invoices, /bullion, /parties with position:fixed on web, tap transitions idle(purple rgb(155,77,255)) → connecting(cyan rgb(0,245,255)) with visible 'Connecting…' pill, and after expected getUserMedia failure it cleanly returns to idle purple (no crash/red-screen). No-regression: existing Now Brief card, Forex/Trips Vault/Charts widgets, sidebar and login flow all intact. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av used indirectly via existing Whisper flow (not modified in Phase 1, worth tracking).

issues: Voice orb renders on the /sign-in screen too (before login). Tapping it there would attempt to hit /api/realtime-token unauthenticated — currently the endpoint uses optional_current_user so it still succeeds, but for security/UX polish consider gating the orb behind an authenticated session.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses `pointerEvents` as a prop on <View> (line 119) which triggers a React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/voice-orb.tsx:119

Web `boxShadow` string is applied via Platform.select which occasionally emits 'Invalid style property of background' warnings from react-native-web when combined with the animated color mixing. Cosmetic only. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/voice-orb.tsx:243

action_items: OPTIONAL: hide/disable the voice orb on unauthenticated routes (e.g. /sign-in) so users cannot tap it before login.
OPTIONAL: move `pointerEvents="box-none"` in voice-orb.tsx to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
Phase-2 tracking (not blocking): expo-av still used by the older Whisper Now-Brief flow — swap to expo-audio when that pipeline is retired as planned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2720 lines — consider splitting realtime + assistant + bullion into routers (not blocking Phase 1).
voice-command endpoint correctly returns 200 with ok=false on unknown actions so the model can recover — matches the spec.
Ephemeral token minting correctly uses server-side OPENAI_API_KEY only; frontend never sees the real sk-proj key. Good.
use-realtime-voice.ts cleanly disconnects on getUserMedia failure and resets state to idle — verified in Playwright.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing seeded parties (Abhishek Singh) and shipments.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-1 Realtime Voice Assistant is fully verified. New backend endpoints: POST /api/realtime-token (returns {ephemeral_key ek_..., expires_at, session_id, model:'gpt-realtime'}) and POST /api/voice-command (actions: get_summary, get_balance, get_shipments; unknown → soft 200 with ok=false). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_realtime_voice.py. Frontend orb testID='voice-orb' rendered globally via VoiceOrbProvider in app/_layout.tsx. Phase-2 will add ghost-typing, Now Brief merge, native WebRTC, and remove ElevenLabs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Phase-1 scope. All acceptance criteria in the review request are met.
